title: Portainer connector configuration
description: Authenticate with either an API key or a username/password pair. The API key takes precedence when both are present.

baseUrl.description: Portainer instance base URL, e.g. https://10.0.0.1.

apiKey.description: Portainer API access token, sent as the X-API-Key header.

username.description: Portainer username, used to mint a JWT when no API key is set.
